title: should style the pause/resume control with the correct variant in both states
verifies: an enabled workflow shows a ghost-destructive pause control and, once paused, a ghost-success resume control

title: should place each branch arm connector at its own source handle
verifies: a two-arm Branch's append connectors have distinct, per-arm start-x coordinates close to their own handles

title: should render the disabled badge inside a wrapping status strip
verifies: disabling a node shows its Disabled badge inside a flex-wrap, max-width-capped status strip
